{{Short description|German mathematician}}
{{Expand French|topic=bio|Johannes Scheubel|date=May 2012}}
'''Johannes Scheubel''' (18 August 1494 – 20 February 1570) was a German mathematician. His books include ''De Numeris et Diversis Rationibus'' (1545)<ref>{{citation|department=Mathematical Treasures|journal=Convergence|publisher=Mathematical Association of America|url=https://www.maa.org/press/periodicals/convergence/mathematical-treasures-johann-scheubels-de-numeris|title=Johann Scheubel's De Numeris|date=January 2011|first1=Frank J.|last1=Swetz|first2=Victor J.|last2=Katz|author-link2=Victor J. Katz}}</ref> and ''Algebrae Compendiosa'' (1551).<ref>{{citation|department=Mathematical Treasures|journal=Convergence|publisher=Mathematical Association of America|url=https://www.maa.org/press/periodicals/convergence/mathematical-treasure-johannes-scheubels-1551-algebra|title=Johannes Scheubel's 1551 Algebra|date=August 2016|first=Sidney J.|last=Kolpas}}</ref>
